exercises.instruction: Complete these definitions with a suitable word.
items: 1 You can borrow books or study there: .....................................
2 You can leave your car there with a lot of other cars: .....................................
3 A place with different kinds of shops, indoors or outdoors: .....................................
4 A place where goods (washing machines, furniture, etc.) are made: .....................................
5 The areas outside the city centre where people live: .....................................
6 An area where there are company offices and banks in a town: .....................................

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word on the right.
items: 1 Some people feel that towns are too ............................ for them to live in. NOISE
2 Generally, the countryside is less ............................ than towns. POLLUTE
3 Living in cities can be very ............................ for some people. STRESS
4 The countryside is much less ............................ than towns. CROWD
5 Some people enjoy the countryside more because it's ............................ . PEACE
6 I always feel ............................ in town than in the countryside. SAFE
7 However, life in town is certainly more ............................ . EXCITE
8 Some people believe it is more ............................ to live in town. DANGER

exercises.instruction: Look at the picture, then complete the text below.
items: This is a picture of a scene in the (1)c............................. . In the distance, you can see a church in the (2)v............................. between the two hills, and on the right-hand hill there is a small (3)w............................. . There is a (4)f............................. leading down from the trees back to the road, and there is a hole or space in the (5)h............................. where you can get through. If you walk along the road towards the cows, you pass a wooden (6)g............................. , and in the (7)f............................. behind that, there is a farmer driving a (8)t............................. .
